final.summary: Outfall pH stayed near neutral 7.18 to 7.64 and lab BOD was 18.2 mg/L, below the 30 mg/L limit, with ETP power matching inflow and a meter photo confirming 69.9 kW at 21:14. Water balance shows outfall flow exceeding treated flow by 232.6 m3 with unaccounted tank water 200.0 m3, while conductivity fell from median 6430 uS/cm to mean 5122.6 uS/cm during the excess and rose sharply as outfall flow dropped after 00:30, indicating groundwater dilution of the outfall.

result.note: ETP balance: treated flow reaching the outfall vs outfall flow (same time). Boundary balance: intake vs outfall + losses + sludge water + tank storage change (reuse cancels).
